question: What Is the Difference Between Actual, Standard and Normal Flow?
body_html:
Actual flow, standard flow and normal flow differ in the pressure and temperature the gas volume refers to. Actual flow is the real volume at operating conditions, while standard and normal flow are corrected to fixed reference conditions so gas quantities can be compared.

Flow typeReference conditionsUnits
ActualOperating pressure and temperatureAm³/h, ACFM
StandardSTP (Standard Temperature and Pressure)Sm³/h, SCFM
NormalNTP (Normal Temperature and Pressure)Nm³/h

Billing and custody transfer use standard or normal flow, because actual volume changes with pressure and temperature.
